about: The editor's running notebook of ongoing storylines. At most 15 threads.

threads.topic: DWP cyber outage and UK cyber resilience
threads.status: Serious cyber incident late 26 Nov knocked Universal Credit, State Pension, PIP and Tell Us Once portals offline on 27 Nov with NCSC and GC3 investigating (payments unaffected); National Cyber Action Plan delayed to 9 Dec.

threads.topic: US Air Force Cloud One breach
threads.status: Hackers exploited software flaw to access control plane of USAF's AWS/Azure/Oracle/Google Cloud hub (CBC2, TICMS across 200+ sites); Cyber Command assessing damage while app migrations and updates remain halted.

threads.topic: UK mortgage shock and winter pressures
threads.status: BoE Financial Stability Report warned 430k homeowners face £500+/mo mortgage jumps (6.5m total) as Ofgem raised Jan-Mar cap 26% to £2,166 and England flu admissions jumped 79% to 8.98 per 100k.

Entered administration 25 Nov under AlixPartners (600 stores, 10k-12k jobs at risk); Commons BIST chair Liam Byrne summoned Gordon Brothers' Mark Newton-Jones with noon 27 Nov deadline for non-insolvency assurances.
UK introduced Cutting Costs (European Partnership) Bill 26 Nov alongside draft UK-EU SPS and ETS-linking treaty texts; EU ministers weigh Ireland's UK car assembly compromise on 3 Dec.

threads.topic: OpenAI hardware suit and GPT-6.2 limits
threads.status: OpenAI and io Products countersued Apple 27 Nov over alleged exfiltration of 100+ hardware files and supplier coercion; OpenAI fixed GPT-6.2 billing bug (Astra 40% / Sol 25% faster limit hit) ahead of Dec ChatGPT-Codex token pool.
USTR proposed 15-35% tariffs on 14 trading partners on 25 Nov (China 0-20% or 40% fallback); written comments close 5 Jan 2027, public hearing starts 25 Jan 2027.
42 US states and DC moved to block 1 Dec bankruptcy auction of 21m users' private chats (2.1m minors) to Delaware entity Smirks and Pangs Acquisition LLC.

threads.topic: F1 Qatar GP, McLaren and 2030 V8 rules
threads.status: Antonelli led Mercedes 1-2 in Qatar FP2 ahead of Norris (P3, +0.445s) and Piastri (P4, +0.472s) before Sat FP3/quali; Red Bull fined €30k (€20k suspended) over Hadjar pit release; FIA confirmed mid-2028 V6 freeze and V8 dyno limits.
Ahead of Eisenkot's 6 Dec mandate deadline, Ra'am's Abbas is set to seek two ministries and address Hamas's terror label while Netanyahu weighs serving second in a rotational unity deal.
CENTCOM disabled Palau-flagged Pacific Archer leaving Bandar Abbas on 26 Nov (sixth ship since July); Iran's Mokhber vowed Hormuz stays closed as rial passed 2.93m/$ and Iraq shut two crossings.

Ukraine proposed Black Sea grain ceasefire 27 Nov via India/Turkey/Egypt and confirmed first Blysk laser drone shoot-down; Zelenskyy rebuked Trump's 'friend' Putin remark; EU 2027 loan decision set for 17-18 Dec.

threads.topic: Nvidia leadership, export curbs and AI hardware
threads.status: Nvidia paused AI server shipments via Dell and Supermicro to Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand and Indonesia on 26 Nov amid US remote-access rules; S&P put Nvidia's AA rating on CreditWatch Negative.
Anthropic detailed zero-downtime Python-to-Rust Messages API migration on 25 Nov (-70% CPU, -80% memory, -20% TTFT) and Luke Sernau's 76k-line Lean Riemann proof passed six checkers by 26 Nov.

threads.topic: Linux 7.5 GPU enablement and AI agent skills
threads.status: AMD queued initial GFX13/RDNA 5 support for Linux 7.5 and Intel enabled Mesa ANV e64 default on 27 Nov; Sasha Levin readied in-tree agents/skills directory for 7.5 merge window.
